title: PurposeTaskSpec.v1
description: A PurposeTask declared by INTENT, not by per-task code. It names a purpose + a capability_slot and a stable input_contract -> output_contract; the controller binds an IMPLEMENTATION from a capability registry by numeric priority (provision-by-capability), runs a cheap deterministic hot path, self-monitors against success_criteria, and on drift self-adapts by running a candidate implementation SIDE-BY-SIDE vs the current one through the governed Parallel-Path Engine — promoting only on a passing PathPromotionDecision and keeping the prior impl as a fallback (rollback_target). success_criteria are MEASURABLE thresholds (e.g. max_cost, min_source_handles, latency_sla, 0 held-out leaks). promotion_criteria are the gates a modified variant must beat. connected_to names the consumers (the blast radius); the output_contract is stable across variants so consumers never break. current_impl_id/alternatives/rollback_target are populated at provision/adaptation time. defined_at is injected (no wall-clock).

task_id.description: stable id of this PurposeTask (content/version hash suffix; never truncation-only)

purpose.description: human-readable intent, e.g. 'Pull the Reg-E error-resolution deadline for a card dispute.'

capability_slot.description: the capability this task satisfies; the controller binds an implementation FROM the registry for this slot by numeric priority (provision-by-capability, not code)

output_contract.description: schema ref the task produces (Y); STABLE across variants so connected_to consumers never break

success_criteria.description: MEASURABLE health thresholds (e.g. max_cost, min_source_handles, latency_sla, held_out leaks = 0); drift below these triggers exactly one governed adaptation cycle

promotion_criteria.description: the gates a modified variant must beat to replace the current impl (cost_tolerance, equivalence, handle-coverage, held-out, safety); promotion is authorized only by a passing PathPromotionDecision

connected_to.description: consumer systems that depend on this task's output (the blast radius)

resources.description: what the task may draw on: templates, skill slots, capability slots, provider graph

current_impl_id.description: the implementation currently bound as the cheap deterministic hot path (set at provision time)

alternatives.description: other implementations for this capability_slot kept as fallback challengers, in priority order

rollback_target.description: the prior implementation the task reverts to if a promotion later fails ('' until a promotion has occurred)

safety_class.description: gate level required (e.g. human approval for real-cloud / write effects)

capabilities.description: OCTS CTS-0: declared capabilities — {required:[], optional:[], forbidden:[]}. Provision is BY declared capability, not code; `forbidden` is a governance boundary (e.g. purchase · credential.access · personal_data.extract) the task may never cross.

allowed_runtime_classes.description: OCTS CTS-0/CTS-1: abstract runtime classes this task may bind to (from architecture/capability_runtime_classes.json); the platform selects a concrete backend by policy. The contract declares the CLASS, never a vendor product.

observability.description: OCTS CTS-2: required telemetry/retained-artifacts (traces=opentelemetry; metrics; retained input/output hashes, trace, eval_result).

defined_at.description: injected time the task was declared (deterministic, no wall-clock)
